sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive recent run of five wins and a draw, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday. Alsager sit bottom of the league with just 4 points and have lost their last five matches, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their lead at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a home fixture against Dawley Town, looking to bounce back from a recent draw and maintain pressure on the leaders. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table after a recent loss, host Eccleshall in a match between two of the division's stronger sides. Wolverhampton Casuals travel to Wednesfield Community in a clash between two mid-table teams, while Bilston Town welcome Foley Meir at home. Barnton host Shawbury United, with Shawbury enduring a difficult run of five consecutive defeats. In other fixtures, Brereton Social face Widnes Town (who are pointless after seven matches), Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a battle of struggling sides, Crewe host Allscott Heath, and Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills.
